note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week.
headline: The Houthi-Saudi war went on. The Saudi-led coalition shot down a drone over the Mecca region on Nov 6 (not claimed by the Houthis, #1355), and on Nov 8 it intercepted a wave of Houthi missiles and a drone aimed at Riyadh, the Eastern Province and the south; debris damaged an Aramco tower in Riyadh but no one was hurt (#1358).

Inside Yemen, a strike on a market in Taiz killed at least 30 on Nov 6; the Houthis blame Saudi airstrikes and Yemen's government blames a Houthi missile (#1356). Airstrikes the Houthis blame on Saudi Arabia killed 27-33 near Sanaa on Nov 7 (#1357).
No US move against the Houthis was found this week: no strike, sanctions, naval action, posture change or talks. The last US strike on the Houthis is still before the May 6, 2025 ceasefire (#1319).
No Houthi attack on US forces or on Red Sea shipping was found this week.
pending: Whether the US joins the Saudi strikes (#1341); no decision found by Nov 9
Whether the Houthis carry out their warning against US interests (#1342)
Whether the Houthis keep their promise of more strikes deep inside Saudi Arabia (#1358)
